ECEN 350/CSCE 350 Computer Architecture and Design

Credits 4. 3 Lecture Hours. 2 Lab Hours.
Basic principles of computer architecture; instruction sets, pipelining, memory hierarchies, I/O.
Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in ECEN 248 and either CSCE 312 or ECEN 250; Cross Listing: CSCE 350/ECEN 350.

ECEN 248 Introduction to Digital Systems Design

Credits 4. 3 Lecture Hours. 3 Lab Hours.
Digital logic, Boolean algebra, combinational and sequential circuits.
Prerequisite: ENGR 217 or PHYS 207; Corequisite: MATH 251.

ECEN 485 Directed Studies  Credits 1 to 4. 1 to 4 Other Hours.

Special problems in electrical or computer engineering not covered by other courses.
Prerequisite: Junior or senior classification and approval of department head.
